items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: It was Jeff Riddick, Raymond Boyk, and myself. And we would play at the intermissions

ctx.x: Did you ever work on Bourbon Street yourself here?

Once. I had one job, and it lasted about a year, at the Famous Door. Two nights a week, a jazz trio. We used to relieve... At that time, George Girard was one of the bands, and the Dukes of Dixieland was the other band at the Famous Door, and the union demanded, of course, they get a night off. Sure. And that would be a Sunday and a Monday, you see. So, when those bands were off, the club provided entertainment in the form of this jazz trio. And I was a member of that trio. It was Jeff Riddick, Raymond Boyk, and…
I guess we'd better... Yeah. I guess we'd better... Yeah. I guess we'd better... Yeah.
